sourcePolicy.atlasAlpha: source is RGB8 and has no alpha; derive matte from black background
sourcePolicy.dataMaps: linear; never import masks, normals or wind weights as sRGB

alphaCutout.surfaceType: Opaque/Cutout; no alpha blending for production foliage cards
alphaCutout.alphaSource: derived matte, stored in baseColor A

extraction.despill: remove black RGB contamination in linear space

alphaCutout.normalPolicy: flip backface normal toward view; preserve tangent handedness
alphaCutout.sorting: opaque queue with alpha test; depth write on
forbidden: sampling source black as valid transparency

channels.mask: R=AO, G=perceptual roughness, B=translucency, A=wetness response
channels.wind: vertex color R=primary bend, G=edge flutter, B=phase offset, A=anchor stiffness

windContract.space: world-space coherent gust plus per-instance phase
windContract.pivot: root at local Y=0; anchor weight must be >=0.95 within lower 8% of height
windContract.phase: stable hash(instance position, assetId); no frame-random phase
windContract.bounds: expand renderer bounds by declared maxDisplacementMeters

seasonWeather.seasonBlend: continuous palette/flower/dryness blend; no topology pop
seasonWeather.wetness01: driven by rain accumulation and drying, not instantaneous rain only
seasonWeather.saltSpray: desaturates exposed tips only; never blue-tint whole plant

lodBillboard.crossFade: dithered 6 m band; synchronize alpha coverage
lodBillboard.note: Bands are authoring targets; profile before acceptance.

ecologyContract.hardReject: all declared ranges and allowed substrate must pass
ecologyContract.softSuitability: multiply moisture, salinity and exposure response; deterministic seed
ecologyContract.placement: align to terrain normal up to maxSlope; preserve root at surface; reject floating or buried roots
ecologyContract.clumping: use declared patch radius and density; do not uniform-random every species
ecologyContract.invasiveMixing: distant community may reference only P06 members and must obey each member hard reject
